name: @red-cup-engineering/cloudflare-tunnel-token-admission-service
description: Admit one named Cloudflare tunnel token to its fixed protected laptop path after offline structural validation.

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: one remotely managed tunnel token, named by --tunnel-name, admitted to its fixed protected laptop path after offline structural validation
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: any token not addressed to a named tunnel, any write outside the fixed per-tunnel token path, and any token disclosure to stdout/stderr

effects: fixed protected local token file for the named tunnel only
